0.title: Data Science
0.text:
Data Science Data Science Data science is the field of extracting insights from data. It combines
    statistics, programming, and domain knowledge to answer questions and make
    predictions from large amounts of information. Tools of the trade Python is the most common language in data science
    because of its rich ecosystem of libraries for analyzing data, building
    charts, and training machine learning models. Where the data lives Before data can be analyzed it has to be collected and stored. Much of it
    lives in databases , which data scientists query
    to pull the records they need. Back to home

1.title: Databases
1.text:
Databases Databases A database is an organized system for storing data so that it can be found
    and updated efficiently. Almost every serious application relies on a
    database to keep its information safe and structured. Querying data Programs read and write data using queries. A query describes what records
    are wanted, and the database returns just those records, even from very large
    collections of data. Databases in practice Databases sit behind most software. A web
    development project stores its users and content in one, and a data science workflow often begins by pulling
    records out of one. Back to home

2.title: Learn Programming — Home
2.text:
Learn Programming — Home Learn Programming Welcome to this small guide. It links out to introductions on popular
    programming languages and the fields where they are used. Start with a
    language or jump straight to a topic like web development or data science. Languages Python — a readable, general purpose language. JavaScript — the language of the web browser. Topics Web development — building websites and web apps. Data science — analyzing data to find insights. Databases — storing and querying structured data.

3.title: JavaScript Programming Language
3.text:
JavaScript Programming Language JavaScript JavaScript is the programming language that runs inside the web browser. It
    makes web pages interactive, responding to clicks, updating content, and
    sending requests without reloading the page. JavaScript and the web JavaScript is a core part of modern web
    development . Together with HTML and CSS it forms the front end that users
    see and interact with in the browser. Beyond the browser JavaScript can also run on servers, letting the same language power both the
    front end and the backend. Server side code often talks to databases to store and retrieve data. Back to home

4.title: Python Programming Language
4.text:
Python Programming Language Python Python is a general purpose programming language known for its clean and
    readable syntax. It is popular with beginners because the code often reads
    almost like plain English, and it is powerful enough for large production
    systems. What Python is used for Python is widely used in data science , where
    libraries make it easy to analyze data and train machine learning models. It
    is also common in web development for
    building the backend of websites and web applications. Working with data Most real programs need to store information. Python connects easily to databases , letting a program save and query
    structured data. Back to home

5.title: Web Development
5.text:
Web Development Web Development Web development is the practice of building websites and web applications. It
    is usually split into two sides: the front end that runs in the browser and
    the backend that runs on a server. The front end The front end is what the user sees. It is built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript , which together control the layout,
    styling, and interactivity of a page. The backend The backend handles logic and data behind the scenes. It can be written in
    many languages, including Python , and it almost
    always relies on databases to store user
    accounts, content, and other structured data. Back to home
